Chapter 994: Chapter 10: Fierce Sun Conceals the Divine (Please Subscribe)

Just a little over half a day had passed.

Lin Yuan had already condensed nine Seeds of the Fierce Sun.

He returned to the level his original body reached after hundreds of years of effort.

“No significant change.”

Lin Yuan observed the nine Seeds of the Fierce Sun inside his body.

“It should be because I originally had already condensed nine Seeds of the Fierce Sun. Even though the Seeds of the Fierce Sun collapsed later, my realm was still there, so even now that I have recovered the nine Seeds, there is no significant change.”

Lin Yuan pondered quietly.

“Then let’s start condensing the tenth Seed of the Fierce Sun.”

Lin Yuan continued his cultivation.

The difference between nine and ten Seeds of the Fierce Sun might be just one seed, but it is a chasm apart.

The difficulty is extremely high.

The original body didn’t know how long it was trapped at nine Seeds of the Fierce Sun and had struggled to condense the tenth one.

The first, tenth, and hundredth Seeds of the Fierce Sun are the hardest to form…

Two hours later.

The tenth Seed of the Fierce Sun slowly took shape.

“This?”

Lin Yuan’s expression changed slightly.

The ten Seeds of the Fierce Sun slowly rotated within his body, resonating with the surrounding heaven and earth, causing waves of dense cosmic rule fluctuations to surge.

Rule fluctuations of the Fang Yuan World, naturally different from those described in the Chaos Void. It shook Lin Yuan profoundly; the rule fluctuations were ten times denser, almost causing him to break into an ‘epiphany.’

“So this is the purpose of the Seeds of the Fierce Sun?”

Lin Yuan calmed himself, feeling somewhat astonished.

Enhancing the perceptiveness to such fluctuations? Such an effect, even if not equal to directly enhancing understanding, is extremely terrifying.

Understanding affects all aspects. For example, Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding doesn’t just far surpass other beings in sensing rules but has incredible effects on all matters.

Such as learning ability? Creative ability and the like?

Despite that.

The ability to directly enhance the perceptiveness to rule fluctuations is extremely rare.

In the Main Universe, certain special beings naturally have stronger perception of certain rules than other beings, but this is an Innate ability.

It’s a talent.

Some treasures and Spiritual Medicines can enhance the perception of certain rules, but they also have time limits, and these treasures are exceptionally precious.

As for treasures that permanently enhance the perception of certain rules? They do exist, but they are coveted fiercely by the Chaos Venerables and Chaos Great Saints.

And now?

Within the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, any being can cultivate the ‘Fierce Sun God-Nurturing Method’, which also has a similar effect?

And with ten Seeds of the Fierce Sun, the amplitude of rule fluctuations increased tenfold, what about twenty seeds? Thirty seeds?

“The Seeds of the Fierce Sun, with this heaven and earth, with this Fang Yuan World…” Lin Yuan’s expression grew slightly solemn.

The ten Seeds of the Fierce Sun floated within his body, subtly communicating with the heaven and earth around him, making Lin Yuan the ‘favorite child’ in the operation of rules.

So it brought about such an extent of rule perception enhancement.

“With the support of ten Seeds of the Fierce Sun, I can reach the pinnacle of the Seventh Realm of Tianshi within a thousand years at most.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Originally, he would have needed at least tens of thousands of years to reach the pinnacle of the Seventh Realm.

Of course, tens of thousands of years is already incredibly short. For those at the twelfth Path Splitting Realm or Master Realm, a nap might span tens of thousands of years, and it might take several Cosmic Eras to progress from the mid-stage to the pinnacle of the Seventh Realm.

“No matter, even if the Fierce Sun God-Nurturing Method has hidden risks, the enhancement in rule perception is real. I’ll continue to condense Seeds of the Fierce Sun. If it comes to it, I’ll just abandon this physical body.”

Lin Yuan made up his mind.

Even the most ordinary people, once they have condensed ten Seeds of the Fierce Sun, could become geniuses in understanding rules. Not to mention someone like Lin Yuan who possesses Against-Heaven’s Understanding?

Combined, their effect far exceeds a simple sum.

…

As Lin Yuan was about to continue cultivating and condense more Seeds of the Fierce Sun.

Suddenly, his expression changed.

He looked toward the entrance of his cave dwelling.

“Yan, how are you now?” A male voice came, it was Yu Chaolong, the original body’s father and the Patriarch of Yu Family.

Yu Chaolong, with the Level Eleven Perfect strength, had long since bought his suitable pathway from Fierce Sun Ancient Country and could step into the Self-Dao Realm at any moment.

“I’m okay.”

Lin Yuan stood up, opened the door of the cave dwelling, seeing his father Yu Chaolong and mother both outside, their faces full of worry.

“That’s good.” Yu Chaolong observed Lin Yuan’s expression, slightly relieved, then angrily said: “That little girl from the Yu Family is really malicious, to do such a thing just to become a disciple of Lord Qingfen.”

“Yes.”

The mother glanced at Lin Yuan.

The relationship between the original body and the Dream of Dongyang was unknown to other family members, not even Yu Chaolong was aware, but the mother was very clear.

“It’s all in the past now.”

Lin Yuan smiled slightly; all the experiences of the original body stemmed from the Dongyang Clan, stemmed from the Dream of Dongyang.

But Lin Yuan did not care much, at most he would wait until his strength was sufficient, then he could crush the entire Dongyang Clan under his foot.

“I have already told your grandfather about this matter. He will surely take charge for you,” his mother Yuchi Ling said.

The Yuchi Clan, being a top-tier clan in the Qingfen Domain, still wielded significant influence despite its decline.

The Dongyang Clan’s assassination attempt on Lin Yuan, out of their desperation to achieve their goals, if this news reached Lord Qingfen, he might just disqualify the Dongyang Clan’s entry right away.

This was, so far, the only thing the Yu Family could do.

The invasion of the Black Drop power by the Dongyang Clan left Lin Yuan’s Seed of Fierce Sun shattered, several of them, plus internal injuries, made it impossible for him to condense new Seeds of the Fierce Sun for tens of years.

In this situation, he no longer qualified to enter the service under Lord Qingfen.

Even if Lord Qingfen despised the Dongyang Clan’s actions and canceled their nomination, he would not accept Lin Yuan, as it had already been decided.

“Let us handle the matter with the Dongyang Clan, son, you just focus on healing,” his father Yu Chaolong spoke.

With the Dongyang Clan having lost the Yu Family as a competitor, they ultimately still hadn’t become a top-tier clan, so the Yu Family would naturally take this opportunity to strike.

“Actually… there is no need to fight against the Dongyang Clan…” Lin Yuan thought for a while and then spoke.

The Yu Family and the Dongyang Clan were both second-tier clans, with similar strengths, battling the Dongyang Clan would be akin to mutual destruction.

In Lin Yuan’s view, this was totally unnecessary; with his growth rate, he would soon reach far beyond the heights of the Dongyang Clan.

By that time, dealing with the Dongyang Clan would just be a thought away.

Although Lin Yuan was only incarnated here, having received Yu Yan’s memories, he still had some bias towards the Yu Family and certainly did not wish to see the Yu Clan members die meaninglessly.

“Not fight with the Dongyang Clan?”

“After what they did to you, my son, I will not let them off,” his father Yu Chaolong narrowed his eyes, “I have already spoken to several of our ancestors about this, the Dongyang Clan will certainly pay the price.”

Hearing this, Lin Yuan did not continue trying to dissuade him.

How could he say that it wouldn’t be long before he grew strong enough to crush the Dongyang Clan? Such a notion, to his father Yu Chaolong, would seem like a fool’s dream.

The Yu family had been on par with the Dongyang Clan for countless millennia, by the power of just Lin Yuan alone?

“I need some cultivation resources,” Lin Yuan said.

Cultivating in Martial Tao required vast amounts of resources, and by relying on the Yu Family’s channels, Lin Yuan wouldn’t need to gather them himself in the early stages.

As for the middle and late stages? Once his strength recovered to a certain level, having self-protective power, just showing a slight hint would naturally bring in a flood of resources.

“These resources… no problem,” his father Yu Chaolong, eyes showing a trace of surprise, finally nodded and said.

“Then we should leave now. If there’s anything you need, feel free to tell me,” Yu Chaolong said, then left with Yuchi Ling.

Watching the two disappear.

Lin Yuan continued to condense the Seeds of the Fierce Sun.

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding, cultivating the Fierce Sun God-Nurturing Method, has condensed the twentieth Seed of the Fierce Sun]

…

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding, cultivating the Fierce Sun God-Nurturing Method, has condensed the thirtieth Seed of the Fierce Sun]

…

Outside the cave dwelling.

Yu Chaolong and Yuchi Ling sat facing each other.

“Are you the Yuchi family really confident about bringing this matter to Lord Qingfen?” Yu Chaolong asked.

The Yuchi family had ultimately declined, otherwise Yu Chaolong would not have been able to marry a direct descendant from a top-tier family.

“We are sure we can bring it up; even if Lord Qingfen doesn’t know, someone under his command will, but knowing it, they probably won’t do much to the Dongyang Clan,” Yuchi Ling shook her head.

For the high and mighty Lord Qingfen, he only cares about results, and what’s the harm in eliminating a competitor?

“Then you earlier…” Yu Chaolong blinked.

“Wasn’t I just comforting our son?” Yuchi Ling glanced at Yu Chaolong.

“I see,” Yu Chaolong nodded.

“It’s a pity, the last condensed Seeds of the Fierce Sun amounted to just nine. If he could condense the tenth, there would be no need to compete with the Dongyang Clan; he could directly enter under Lord Qingfen’s command,” Yuchi Ling sighed.

The difference between nine Seeds of the Fierce Sun and ten is profound.

Being able to condense ten Seeds of the Fierce Sun before the age of five hundred, even the high and mighty Lord Qingfen would take another look.

Such a talent, if he were killed in an assassination, Lord Qingfen would inquire and punish the family power behind it.

Simply put, if Yu Yan’s condensed Seeds of the Fierce Sun reached ten, even if he walked openly into the Dongyang family, he would still come out unscathed.

“Yu Yan… still needs some more time to be comforted,” Yu Chaolong thought, influenced by the Black Drop, several Seeds of the Fierce Sun shattered, plus injuries that meant he could not condense new Seeds of the Fierce Sun for decades.

In Yu Chaolong’s view, Lin Yuan’s future potential was likely greatly diminished.

“Ten Seeds of the Fierce Sun? When was the last time such a genius was born in our Qingfen Domain?”

Yuchi Ling shook her head, the initial rise of the Yuchi family was because they birthed a genius who, under five hundred, condensed ten Seeds of the Fierce Sun.

“Let’s not talk about this anymore, even if Yan can’t condense ten Seeds of the Fierce Sun, he is still our son,” Yu Chaolong said.

…

Time passed.

Months went by in the blink of an eye.

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding, cultivating the Fierce Sun God-Nurturing Method, has condensed the three thousand six hundred eighty-ninth Seed of the Fierce Sun]

Lin Yuan leisurely opened his eyes, countless rounds of the Fierce Sun fluctuating within his pupils.
